inheritedEvidence.obligations: Pure domain accumulator, accepted counters, exact progress projections, extension point and unchanged standalone/event/RNG parity.

Active-only playtime, immutable ending/history/maxima, single/paired interrupted replacement, counter-only timed-v2 migration, supported legacy/corrupt recovery and actual lifecycle/earned legal journey obligations. UI-only changes do not alter any of these inputs.

acceptance.AC2: Injected monotonic clock and current fake visibility/focus, closed/recovery/menu/dialog exclusion, actual Chromium background/navigation/BFCache: increment 2.

acceptance.AC4: Frozen terminal/abandoned stats, first result immutable, single/paired receipts and interruption/recovery, bounded maxima/eviction/ties/reset: increment 2.
acceptance.AC5: All five recent fields, per-mode bests and retained winning summary; unavailable/partial/N/A labels; keyboard focus, native touch/WebKit portrait/landscape: 15 current UI cases and reviewed retained screenshots.
acceptance.AC6: Timed stats v2, authored 11/dungeon 13 and history payload v2 preserve old readers/recovery/read-only behavior; literal actual counter-only writer fixtures and per-field completeness: increment 2 plus current UI/recovery proof.
acceptance.AC7: Short accepted-domain-event extension note in docs/run-records.md; future damage breakdowns remain out of scope.
acceptance.AC8: Every direct route/diagnostic/override/Qbert entry tested against missing/valid/corrupt/backup-only/unavailable player saves/history. 75 unique engine/profile permutations qualified as 30 unaffected Chromium +15 repaired Chromium +30 WebKit, plus active no-stats assertions and no storage reads/writes.
